increment_status: Native Step 24 implemented under Boss-approved revised contract; focused Linux Debug/strict acceptance passed; independent Wrench review and native platform acceptance pending

approved_contract.authority: Boss explicitly approved Golden Wrench revision in this chat on 22 October 2026
approved_contract.queued_and_readiness: Prompt cancellation of queued operations and interruptible readiness waits.
approved_contract.entered_syscalls: Best-effort cancellation only; retain bytes, adapters, leases and Runtime/participant lifetime until actual completion. External host/device activity can keep shutdown blocked.
approved_contract.deadline: One monotonic deadline covers buffer preparation, admission, readiness/retry and partial transfers. It does not forcibly bound an already-entered uncancellable syscall. Successful final completion remains successful; further required work stops with the precise known prefix.
approved_contract.prohibitions: No mandatory io_uring, borrowed descriptor duplication/closure/replacement, process-wide descriptor flag changes, unrelated-host cancellation, detached native requests, duplicate I/O registry/framework or process-global signal handler.

implemented: Extended existing Adapter/Context/Operation with native-owned Bytes, ReadResult/Transfer and portable/native/secondary cleanup errors. No source API or new C/IR Runtime operation.
Native real byte reads and complete record writes with positive short progress, EOF, zero-count/no-progress handling, EINTR/EAGAIN retry, precise completed counts and retained consumed partial input.

Deadline-aware existing gate admission; -1 wait, zero poll, positive one monotonic deadline across all progress/retries, saturating large timeout without overflow. Existing thread/token/NativeSafe/closing safeguards retained.

POSIX real read/write and interruptible poll with operation-scoped owned nonblocking close-on-exec wake pipes. Original endpoint availability snapshots govern every transfer, including initially absent std fds reused by another operation. Host descriptors/flags and PTY/stdio state untouched.

Per-thread scoped SIGPIPE mask/pending preservation and own-EPIPE signal consumption, exact original error and secondary cleanup preservation. Linux verified; Darwin pending/sigwait branch unverified.

Windows redirected-byte path uses actual handle-mode queries, owned synchronous worker or request-specific OVERLAPPED/event, exact-target best-effort cancellation and complete draining. Completion counts use the real OS result; original metadata output storage also retained if pending. No ANSI/ACP/CRT assumptions. Native build/execution unverified.

Full-write stdout/stderr serialization and shared native input gate retained across Runtime sessions, precise roots/GC progress during actual blocked IO, queued stop and entered-call lifetime without abandoned buffers.

strict_sanitizers.execution: Outside restricted ptrace runner for actual LeakSanitizer checking. No sanitizer/leak error, assertion removal or safety bypass. Existing fatal-invariant children and native leak-negative controls remain enabled.

development_failures_and_repairs.failure: First native endpoint test hung with closed stdin: creating the wake pipe reused fd 0 and native code could read/poll the wake fd as input.
development_failures_and_repairs.repair: Validate the original endpoint availability before any wake allocation; strengthened below to retain the immutable snapshot for every transfer.

development_failures_and_repairs.failure: A deterministic concurrent output wait used wake fd 0 while stdin was originally absent; fresh fstat-based checking mistook that wake fd for available input.
development_failures_and_repairs.repair: POSIX SystemAdapter captures original roles/kinds/errors once and uses that immutable availability for all transfers. Sequential and concurrent regressions remain enabled.

development_failures_and_repairs.fixture_observation: The first expanded race probe passed unexpectedly because /proc inspection could occupy fd 0 before wake allocation. A non-opening fcntl barrier establishes descriptor reuse before /proc observation.
development_failures_and_repairs.outcome: Strengthened counterexample then reproduced the production defect. No production check disabled.

development_failures_and_repairs.review: Retry loops retain secondary cleanup errors instead of discarding them; deterministic regression passes. Windows metadata/overlapped completion and request-storage lifetime reviewed; native Windows verification still required.
development_failures_and_repairs.claim_limit: No previously captured native Windows failure or its repair is claimed.

resolved_blocker.method: Boss-approved cancellation contract revision, not a claim that readiness cancels entered syscalls. No repeated io_uring/AIO feasibility investigation or dependency adoption.
resolved_blocker.probe_maintenance: Historical Metadata probe gained only no-I/O pure-interface overrides so it remains buildable after Adapter extension; historical native cases were not re-investigated.

unresolved_observations: One early current-revision publication assertion failed without further diagnostics. It did not reproduce with explicit contract checks or a minimal variant without them. A later final-source default-root run failed operator_reload and temporal_ir with _year/year library diagnostics; original library bytes subsequently matched the baseline, and isolated, explicit-original-root and default-root reruns passed. External interference is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. Final acceptance uses the exact baseline library in a verified isolated root. No check was disabled; these earlier observations remain unexplained and retained for independent review.
documented_limits: Entered uncancellable syscall may outlive timeout/stop and block shutdown until external progress; this is the approved contract, not a hidden implementation omission.
Independent host output writers can interleave and invalidate readiness; no rollback/reserved pipe capacity promise.
No mixing of independent input readers beyond the existing single-input-owner contract.
Zero-byte requests succeed without IO/gate/EOF probing, including after close; invalid controls still reject.
Native C++ adapters/spans remain a trusted embedding boundary, must not contain GC-managed borrows; host Runtime/participant lifetime rules remain.

Windows confirmed consoles require Step 26 wide path, not this raw byte adapter. Explicit-offset overlapped disk handles cannot provide ordered shared-stream position and report unsupported; no host offset is invented.
Standard-signal coalescing remains an OS limit for unrelated concurrently injected SIGPIPE; preexisting pending signals/masks/dispositions are preserved.
